SELECT match_type
FROM marketing.ignore_list
WHERE
     (match_type = 'email'  AND lower(value) = :email)
  OR (match_type = 'domain' AND (lower(value) = :domain
                                 OR :domain LIKE '%.' || lower(value)))
  OR (match_type = 'prefix' AND :email LIKE lower(value) || '%')
  OR (match_type = 'suffix' AND :domain LIKE '%' || lower(value))
LIMIT 1

# ---- Safe parse: registration_answers may arrive as Array OR JSON string ----
raw = input["registration_answers"]
ra =
  if raw.is_a?(Array)
    raw
  elsif raw.is_a?(String) && !raw.strip.empty?
    (parse_json(raw) rescue [])
  else
    []
  end

# ---- YOUR logic: match by exact label ----
by_label = ->(label, key = "answer") {
  hit = ra.find { |a| a["label"] == label }
  hit && hit[key]
}

# ---- MY logic: match by question_type (stable across events) ----
by_type = ->(type, key = "answer") {
  hit = ra.find { |a| a["question_type"] == type }
  hit && hit[key]
}

# ---- MY logic: keyword fallback on label ----
by_keyword = ->(words, key = "answer") {
  hit = ra.find { |a|
    l = a["label"].to_s.downcase
    words.any? { |w| l.include?(w) }
  }
  hit && hit[key]
}

# treat empty strings as nil so fallbacks kick in
clean = ->(v) { (v.nil? || v.to_s.strip.empty?) ? nil : v }

# Safe time parser: ISO string or time object -> Time, nil on failure
parse_time = ->(v) {
  begin
    if v.nil?
      nil
    elsif v.is_a?(String)
      v.strip.empty? ? nil : Time.parse(v)
    else
      v.to_time
    end
  rescue
    nil
  end
}

# ===== EVENT ID (your logic, unchanged) =====
event_id = input["url"].to_s.split("/").last

# ==========================================================
# ===== LUMA IDs =====
# ==========================================================
url_path      = input["url"].to_s.strip.split("?").first.to_s.split("#").first.to_s.chomp("/")
luma_url_slug = clean.(url_path.split("/").last)      # agentic-web-browser-runtime-nov11-2026
luma_guest_id = clean.(input["guest_id"].to_s.strip)   # gst-yEYYnDeyn3n8gTw

# ==========================================================
# ===== STATUS / SOURCE / CHECK-IN =====
# ==========================================================
luma_approval_status = clean.(input["approval_status"].to_s.strip.downcase)   # approved / pending_approval

src          = clean.(input["source"].to_s.strip)
event_source = src ? src.capitalize : "Luma"

checked_in_time            = parse_time.(input["check_in_date"])
luma_event_checked_in_date = checked_in_time ? checked_in_time.utc.iso8601 : nil

# ==========================================================
# ===== EVENT START / END / TIMEZONE =====
# ==========================================================
start_time     = parse_time.(clean.(input["start_at"]) || input["event_date"])
end_time       = parse_time.(input["end_at"])
event_timezone = clean.(input["timezone"])

event_start_date = start_time ? start_time.utc.iso8601 : nil
event_end_date   = end_time   ? end_time.utc.iso8601   : nil
event_date       = event_start_date

to_local = ->(t) {
  begin
    (t && event_timezone) ? t.in_time_zone(event_timezone) : nil
  rescue
    nil
  end
}
start_local = to_local.(start_time)
end_local   = to_local.(end_time)

event_start_local = start_local ? start_local.iso8601 : nil
event_end_local   = end_local   ? end_local.iso8601   : nil
event_local_date  = start_local ? start_local.strftime("%Y-%m-%d") : nil

event_local_time =
  if start_local && end_local
    start_local.strftime("%b %-d, %Y · %-l:%M %p") + " – " + end_local.strftime("%-l:%M %p %Z")
  elsif start_local
    start_local.strftime("%b %-d, %Y · %-l:%M %p %Z")
  else
    nil
  end

# ==========================================================
# ===== ROUTING: new flow (Nov 1+) vs old flow =====
# ==========================================================
cutoff = clean.(input["new_flow_start_date"]).to_s.strip
cutoff = "2026-11-01" unless cutoff =~ /\A\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}\z/

# Local event day (falls back to UTC day if timezone missing)
event_day    = event_local_date || (start_time ? start_time.utc.strftime("%Y-%m-%d") : nil)
is_new_event = !event_day.nil? && event_day >= cutoff

new_flow_statuses = ["approved", "pending_approval"]
old_flow_statuses = ["approved"]
status            = luma_approval_status.to_s

route, route_reason =
  if event_day.nil?
    ["skip", "missing event start date"]
  elsif is_new_event
    new_flow_statuses.include?(status) ? ["new", nil] : ["skip", "new flow: status '#{status}' not handled"]
  else
    old_flow_statuses.include?(status) ? ["old", nil] : ["skip", "old flow: status '#{status}' not handled"]
  end

# ===== LINKEDIN =====
li = clean.(by_label.("What is your LinkedIn profile?")) ||
     clean.(by_label.("LinkedIn profile")) ||
     clean.(by_type.("linkedin")) ||
     clean.(by_keyword.(["linkedin"]))
linkedin =
  if li.nil?
    nil
  elsif li.start_with?("http")
    li
  else
    "https://www.linkedin.com" + (li.start_with?("/") ? li : "/#{li}")
  end

# ===== COMPANY =====
company = clean.(by_label.("Where do you work?")) ||
          clean.(by_label.("What company do you work for?")) ||
          clean.(by_type.("company", "answer_company")) ||
          clean.(by_type.("company")) ||
          clean.(by_keyword.(["company", "where do you work", "employer"]))

# ===== JOB TITLE =====
job_title = clean.(by_label.("What is your job title?")) ||
            clean.(by_label.("What company do you work for?", "answer_job_title")) ||
            clean.(by_type.("company", "answer_job_title")) ||
            clean.(by_keyword.(["job title", "role title", "your role"]))

# ===== COUNTRY =====
country = clean.(by_label.("What country are you from?")) ||
          clean.(by_label.("Where are you from?"))        ||
          clean.(by_label.("Country of residence"))        ||
          clean.(by_keyword.([
            "what country", "which country", "country",
            "where are you from", "where are you based",
            "based in", "residence", "nationality"
          ]))
country = "United Kingdom" if country == "United Kingdon"

# ==========================================================
# ===== BLOCKED COUNTRIES =====
# ==========================================================
raw_bc = input["blocked_countries"]
blocked_list =
  if raw_bc.is_a?(Array)
    raw_bc
  elsif raw_bc.is_a?(String) && !raw_bc.strip.empty?
    (parse_json(raw_bc) rescue [])
  else
    []
  end
blocked_list = [] unless blocked_list.is_a?(Array)

norm = ->(v) { v.to_s.strip.downcase.gsub(/\s+/, " ") }
country_n = norm.(country)

matched_block =
  if country_n.empty?
    nil
  else
    blocked_list.find { |b|
      next false unless b.is_a?(Hash)
      b_name = norm.(b["country"])
      b_iso  = norm.(b["country_iso_code"])
      (!b_name.empty? && b_name == country_n) ||
      (!b_iso.empty?  && b_iso  == country_n)
    }
  end

country_blocked     = !matched_block.nil?
blocked_country_iso = country_blocked ? matched_block["country_iso_code"] : nil

# ==========================================================
# ===== email/domain + ignore decision (from Postgres) =====
# ==========================================================
full_email    = input["user_email"].to_s.strip.downcase
domain        = full_email.include?("@") ? full_email.split("@").last : ""
contact_email = clean.(full_email)

pg_match = input["pg_match_count"].to_i > 0

reasons = []
reasons << (clean.(input["pg_match_type"]) || "email_match") if pg_match
reasons << "blocked_country: #{country}"                     if country_blocked

should_ignore = !reasons.empty?
ignore_reason = should_ignore ? reasons.join(" | ") : nil

{
  # ===== existing outputs (unchanged) =====
  "event_id"                   => event_id,
  "event_name"                 => input["name"],
  "first_name"                 => input["user_first_name"],
  "last_name"                  => input["user_last_name"],
  "email"                      => input["user_email"],
  "phone_number"               => input["phone_number"],
  "hs_linkedin_url"            => linkedin,
  "company"                    => company,
  "job_title"                  => job_title,
  "country"                    => country,
  "luma_last_checked_in_date"  => input["check_in_date"],
  "email_domain"               => domain,
  "should_ignore"              => should_ignore,
  "ignore_reason"              => ignore_reason,
  "country_blocked"            => country_blocked,
  "blocked_country_iso"        => blocked_country_iso,

  # ===== HubSpot "Event registration" fields =====
  "luma_url_slug"              => luma_url_slug,
  "luma_guest_id"              => luma_guest_id,
  "luma_approval_status"       => luma_approval_status,
  "luma_event_checked_in_date" => luma_event_checked_in_date,
  "contact_email"              => contact_email,
  "event_date"                 => event_date,
  "event_source"               => event_source,

  # ===== routing =====
  "route"                      => route,
  "route_reason"               => route_reason,
  "event_day"                  => event_day,

  # ===== extra event timing =====
  "event_start_date"           => event_start_date,
  "event_end_date"             => event_end_date,
  "event_timezone"             => event_timezone,
  "event_start_local"          => event_start_local,
  "event_end_local"            => event_end_local,
  "event_local_date"           => event_local_date,
  "event_local_time"           => event_local_time
}

description:
# LUMA-00 | Fun 001 | Check Guest Ignore Rules

**📋 Ticket:** [Luma guests → Salesforce campaign members](https://brightdata-group.monday.com/boards/8667788707/pulses/13343839880)

---

**TRIGGER:** Called by `Webhook: Luma-to-HubSpot Guest Sync` (first step). Reusable by any Luma / event process.

**PURPOSE:** Normalize a Luma guest and decide whether it must be ignored (ignore list or blocked country) before any processing.

**FLOW:**
1. Match email / domain against `marketing.ignore_list` → PostgreSQL
2. Get active `blocked_countries` → Data table → list
3. Ruby `normalize_luma_guest` (unchanged): Luma fields, HubSpot fields, routing, ignore decision

**DB / TABLES:** `marketing.ignore_list` (read), `blocked_countries` data table (read)
**UPSTREAM:** Webhook: Luma-to-HubSpot Guest Sync  
**DOWNSTREAM:** none

## Important logic
- Inputs = the Luma webhook fields of the original Ruby step; outputs = all its outputs + `status` / `message`.
- `should_ignore` = ignore-list match OR blocked country. `ignore_reason` joins all reasons with ` | `.
- `registration_answers`: pass a JSON string (`.to_json`).
- Caller must stop when `status = Error` or `should_ignore = true`.
name: LUMA-00 | Fun 001 | Check Guest Ignore Rules
